heading: The eleventh day of October, in the seventh year of Kunrad IV. Third desk, second floor. Four matters heard.
burnt_out_text: The candle went before the queue did. The doorkeeper turned the rest of them out into the passage and told them to come back on Thursday.

case_slots._note: The knife. Placed last on Tuesday deliberately: the player has just been handed a case where two laws disagree and told that referring is the only honest answer, and then one more man comes in with a packet where every check they have been taught comes back clean. It is the day's sting in the tail and it sets up Thursday.
